$comment: Specification version 2.0.0, wire-format version 2. Normative text: docs/spec/paylink-invoice-v2.md. Changing this schema in a way that accepts or rejects different wire data requires a new specification version (section 16).
title: PayLink signed invoice, wire-format version 2
description: Canonical JSON form of a PayLink v2 signed invoice and its companion objects (payment authorisation, signed cancellation, relayer request bodies, receipt reference). Normative text: docs/spec/paylink-invoice-v2.md, section 11. A schema validator checks structure, ranges and the memo presence rule only. Consumers MUST also verify EIP-55 checksums of mixed-case addresses, the 280-byte UTF-8 limit of the memo and its hash, the uint128/uint256 upper bounds of decimal strings, the invoice shape rules of section 3.1 that involve verifyingContract or two fields, and, when present, that `key` equals the key recomputed with the registry's verifyingContract.

Address.description: 20-byte EVM address, 0x-prefixed. Producers MUST write the EIP-55 checksummed form; consumers MUST verify the checksum of any mixed-case address.

Signature.description: Payee signature, 0x-prefixed lowercase hexadecimal, 1 to 512 bytes. EOA payees: exactly 65 bytes r || s || v with v in {27, 28} and low s (section 6.2). ERC-1271 payees: opaque bytes (section 6.3).

ChainId.description: EIP-155 chain ID within the uint53 range. It MUST have a canonical deployment in the consumer's registry.

Uint53Seconds.description: Unix time in seconds. The contract type is uint64, but conforming values stay within the uint53 range (section 3.1).

Uint128String.description: uint128 as a canonical decimal string (no sign, no leading zeros). Consumers MUST reject values above 340282366920938463463374607431768211455.

Uint256String.description: uint256 as a canonical decimal string (no sign, no leading zeros). Consumers MUST reject values above 2^256 - 1.

Invoice.description: The eight-field EIP-712 Invoice struct (section 3.1). The schema enforces payee != 0x0 and memoHash != keccak256(""). Shape rules that a schema cannot express: payee and token differ from verifyingContract, and validUntil == 0 or validUntil >= validAfter.

payee.description: Receives the funds and signs the invoice: an EOA or a deployed ERC-1271 account. MUST NOT be the zero address.

token.description: ERC-20 token, or 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 for the native coin. MUST be in the registry allowlist for the chain.

amount.description: Token base units. "0" means an open amount.

salt.description: 32 bytes from a CSPRNG, fresh for every invoice.

memoHash.description: keccak256 of the memo's exact UTF-8 bytes, or 32 zero bytes when there is no memo. An empty memo is encoded as 32 zero bytes, never as keccak256("").

Memo.description: Free text from the payee, at most 280 bytes of UTF-8 (the schema can only bound code points). Untrusted: strip bidirectional and control characters before display.

SignedInvoice.description: A signed invoice (section 11). `memo` is present if and only if invoice.memoHash is not 32 zero bytes (enforced below), and it MUST hash to memoHash (checked by the consumer).

key.description: OPTIONAL and redundant: the EIP-712 digest of the invoice under the deployment's domain. If present, consumers MUST recompute it and reject the object on a mismatch.

PaymentAuthorization.description: The payer's EIP-3009 receiveWithAuthorization signature for payWithAuthorization (section 8). The token nonce is not carried: it is recomputed as paymentNonce(key, payer, amount, payerRef, payerSalt).

payerRef.description: Public and not unique. Must not contain personal data.

payerSalt.description: Fresh random bytes for every attempt.

CancelAuthorization.description: A payee-signed EIP-712 Cancel(bytes32 key,uint256 deadline) for cancelBySig (section 9.2). It is also the request body of a relayer's POST /v1/{chainId}/cancel (section 11.2); the relayer MUST reject it if chainId differs from the chain in the path.

RelayPayRequest.description: Request body of a relayer's POST /v1/{chainId}/pay (section 11.2). The relayer MUST reject the request if chainId differs from the chain in the path, then apply section 13.3: decode, check the shape, verify payeeSig with the registry's verifyingContract, recompute the binding nonce of section 8.2 and simulate before sending payWithAuthorization. The memo is never sent to a relayer.

ReceiptReference.description: Identifies one Paid event (sections 10.6 and 12). Verify it on RPC; never trust an indexer for it.

logIndex.description: Block-level log index of the Paid event.
